The agent ran the entire Mocha suite after the relevant temporary tests, 178 group/meta tests, and 272 user tests had passed, but piped all output through `tail` to a file that would only contain results when the pipeline finished. The operation timed out after several minutes, leaving no usable progress log. For this broad optional run, redirecting Mocha output directly to a live log—or stopping after the targeted verification—would have preserved information at lower cost.

run_review.reason: The run remained directed and obtained passing targeted tests, but avoidable work accumulated: it invoked Mocha on a nonexistent test file, repeatedly rewrote an existing temporary test instead of making small fixture changes, and restarted Redis in separate calls after seeing it disappear between calls. A later full-suite command timed out without retaining usable progress output.
